log.query: Groww founders Lalit Keshre Harsh Jain Ishan Bansal Neeraj Singh status 2025 2026
log.found: All four founders remain active. Groww IPO'd in Nov 2025 (listed on NSE). Lalit Keshre is CEO, Harsh Jain is COO, Ishan Bansal is CFO, Neeraj Singh is CTO. All four are Whole-time Directors.
No departures. All four founders still in executive roles per board of directors.
